basic_profile.bio: PixelPonderer is a 27-year-old tech enthusiast residing in Austin, Texas. With a background in computer science, they work as a software developer for a mid-sized tech company. They have a keen interest in retro gaming and digital art, often spending their free time exploring these hobbies. Although not deeply religious, they have a curiosity about various spiritual and philosophical topics, leading them to explore subreddits like Hermetics. Single and enjoying the freedom of the tech lifestyle, they are most active on Reddit during evenings and late nights.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: PixelPonderer has a bachelor's degree in computer science and a passion for learning. They are largely self-taught in areas like game development and digital art, often utilizing online resources and community forums. Their interest in spirituality and philosophy stems from personal exploration and reading.
